args.title: Freight pricing summary — Saltmarsh blog + companion piece
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/freight/companion):

• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least (companion piece finding).
